says: The start's span records fab.permissions.subject, permission, object and outcome, which the plan's 'What this records' promises and 0202 keeps forever, but no law reads any of them, so a wrong or dropped attribute passes.
proof: `rg -n "fab.permissions" next` finds the names only in ChildrenLedger.ts and RelationsLedger.ts; no test file names one.
cost: A start's who, what and outcome could stop being recorded, or be recorded wrong, with every check green; spans written meanwhile never get the right value back.
